# Idea

Sui  
they want nice ux experience and something to solve real life solution

Thetanuts track 2 (seansean)  
Problem:  
\- Crypto holder know they should protect their position before drop, but dont understand strikes, options work  
\- So they dont hedge or panic sell and loss money

Idea:  
\- chat based assistant (web page / integrate telegram bot (maybe see if doable within this time)  
\- agent read live option market on thetanuts  
\- pick a real option that can protect the user  
\- show details(how much it cover, cost etc)  
\- user confirm, agent place trade

flow  
User (chat input)   
  → LLM agent (reads command, decides what to check)  
  → MCP server tools (fetch live orderbook, get market data, build tx)  
  → LLM explains the trade (cost, breakeven, protection) in plain text  
  → User confirms  
  → Signer (your disposable wallet) signs and submits  
  → Real fill lands on Base mainnet

why this solution (complete \> complex)  
\- can directly pull live from actual market, no hardcoded/mock part  
\- direct show real cost, coverage with live data  
\- explain why certain option is chosen based on real number not vague answer  
\- demo output is verified (can check on thetanuts service)

Add ons to make it more unique

- personalised risk profile (user choose conservative/aggressive preference when login first time, then make agent more personalised based on this)  
- show 2-3 options instead of showing 1 with different tradeoff (cheaper but less coverage / expensive but full coverage )  
- agent suggest amount themselves by reading wallet balance, instead of user type amount

# Tab 5

spot:  
current price: 1000  
price rise to 1100  
earn 100 with cost 1000

price drops to 900  
loss 1000 \- 900 \=100

option like a contract:

1. strike price: 1100   
2. expire date: 29/9  
3. premium: 10

call option: (buy in)  
scenario 1:  
831-\> 1200: buy with 1100, earn 100 \-10 \=90, cost 10, earn 90, like leverage  
28/9: price drops: 1000, contract expired, loss 10 (premium)

put option (sell)

1. strike price: 900, you got 1 btc  
2. expire date: 29/9

831-\> 800, 900-800 \-premium  
sell 1 btc to market maker, 900, use 800 to buy back the btc  
1btc \+ 100 \-\> profit: 100

buyer-\> thetanuts \<- seller (market maker)

option in thetanuts is cash settled, means that you dont really sell / buy bitcoin at the end  
for example, in put option, you dont really sell 1 btc to the seller, you just ‘give’ the seller 900 usd, no btc is transferred between buyer and seller

1 btc 1000 usd  
lending platform-\> stake 1 btc, they borrow you 600usd,  you pay interest

policy of lending platform:  
your debt can’t more than 80% of your asset value  
600 / 0.8 \= 750, this means that if bitcoin price drops lower than 750, you will get liquidated  
how liquidation works?   
The lending platform will not liquidate your asset in one time. They only do half of your debt value \+ 8% bonus as penalty (if your debt is 600 usd, they will only do 300 usd and 8% of bonus)  
   
lets walk through the whole flow in the example below  
Day 1  
Current btc price: 1000 usd  
Dennis has 1 btc and he stake it on lending platform to get 600 usd  
So the liquidation price for Dennis is 600/0.8 \= 750 usd

Then Dennis also open a put option on strike price 750 usd and premium of 25 usd

Day 10  
Current bitcoin price: 700 usd

SInce btc price fell below 750 usd, dennis collateral get liquidated, how much of the collateral got liquidated?

**If Dennis didn’t open a put option:**  
Dennis debt is 600 usd  
600 \* 0.5 \= 300 (half of your debt)  
0.08 \* 300 \= 24 (8% bonus as the penalty)  
Total \= 324, btc worth 324 usd get liquidated  
Since current btc price is 700, so 700 \- 324 \= 376  
So dennis still got 376 / 700 \= 0.54 btc stake in the lending platform as collateral

So lets see what dennis got in this moment:  
0.54 btc (stake in lending platform)  
300 usd in debt (because liquidation earlier help you pay 300 usd)

**if dennis open a put option:**  
profit for put option \= 750 \- 700 \= 50 usd  
he uses that 50 usd to pay the debt, 600 \- 50 \= 550usd  
Then the liquidation price is 550 / 0.8 \= 687.5 usd  
the liquidation price updated, now dennis asset wont get liquidated by the lending platform

Day 15  
current bitcoin price: 1000 usd  
lets see the net worth of two version of Dennis (buy a put option and without put option)

|  | Without put option | WIth put option |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| BTC | 0.54 (540 usd) | 1 (1000 usd) |
| debt | \-300 | \-550 |
| premium | 0 | \-25 |
| net | 240 | 425 |
